title: Broken Object Level Authorization
description: The API allows users to access order records by manipulating the ID without proper authorization checks.
impact: Attackers can access, modify, or delete any order belonging to other users, leading to data breach and financial fraud.
fix: Implement object-level authorization on every endpoint that accesses data objects. Validate that the authenticated user has permission to access the specific resource.
technical: Missing ownership validation in OrderController.getById(). The user ID from JWT is not compared against the order's owner field before returning data.

title: Broken Authentication
description: Authentication mechanism is vulnerable to brute-force attacks due to missing rate limiting. Password reset tokens do not expire.
impact: Complete account takeover. Attackers can compromise any user account through automated credential stuffing or brute-force.
fix: Implement rate limiting (max 5 attempts/minute). Add CAPTCHA after 3 failed attempts. Set 15-minute expiry on password reset tokens.
technical: No rate limiting middleware on the /auth route. Redis-based distributed rate limiting required for multi-instance deployments.

title: Broken Object Property Level Auth
description: The API exposes sensitive fields (role, isAdmin, internalScore) in API responses that should be restricted.
impact: Unauthorized access to sensitive metadata. May enable privilege escalation through mass assignment.
fix: Implement response filtering. Use allowlist-based serialization. Review all response schemas for data leakage.
technical: UserSerializer includes all model fields by default. Need explicit field allowlisting in serializer configuration.

title: Broken Function Level Authorization
description: Admin-only export functionality is accessible without authentication.
impact: Any unauthenticated user can export the full analytics dataset containing PII and business-sensitive metrics.
fix: Add JWT authentication middleware. Validate role claim includes "admin" scope before processing.
technical: The export route is registered after the authentication middleware exclusion list. Move it before the exclusion block.

title: Security Misconfiguration
description: API key transmitted via query string. CORS policy allows all origins. Missing security headers.
impact: API credentials exposed in server logs and browser history. CSRF attacks possible across origins.
fix: Move API key to Authorization header. Restrict CORS to trusted origins. Add X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options headers.
technical: CORS_ORIGINS env var is set to "*" in production config. API key passed as ?api_key= query parameter.

title: Unrestricted Resource Consumption
description: Batch processing endpoint accepts unlimited items in a single request without size limits.
impact: Denial of service through resource exhaustion. Memory and CPU spikes can crash the service.
fix: Implement request size limits (max 100 items per batch). Add queue-based processing for large batches.
technical: No validation on request.body.items array length. Direct processing without throttling.

title: Broken Access Control
description: Password reset endpoint allows token reuse and lacks IP-based rate limiting.
impact: Attackers can reset passwords for any user by reusing leaked tokens from previous reset emails.
fix: Implement one-time-use tokens with immediate invalidation. Add IP-based rate limiting (3 attempts/hour).
technical: Reset tokens stored in database without used flag. No IP tracking on reset requests.

title: Improper Inventory Management
description: Deprecated API endpoints remain accessible without deprecation warnings.
impact: Clients continue using outdated endpoints, making migration difficult and increasing maintenance burden.
fix: Add Sunset header with deprecation date. Implement automatic redirect to new endpoints with warning.
technical: Legacy routes registered without deprecation middleware. No versioning strategy in place.
